note: Lean proves that integrals against continuous compactly supported tests converge to those of the limit measure when the Laplace transforms converge, by density of exponentials; this identifies the limit directly, without Riesz extraction of subsequences, holomorphic uniqueness or Fourier inversion.

snippet.text:
theorem laplace_compact (f : E4 → ℝ) (hc : Continuous f) (hp : HasCompactSupport f) :
    Tendsto (fun i => ∫ p,f p ∂μ i) l (𝓝 (∫ p,f p ∂ν)) := by
    let u : inside := ⟨_,clock_inside⟩
    obtain ⟨x,h⟩ := decode_compact f hc hp u
    rw [← (compact_evaluation (u:=u) h ν hν).1]
    apply (laplace_continuous μ ν hf hν hx x u).congr'
    filter_upwards [hf] with i hi using (compact_evaluation h (μ i) hi).1

proof_context.conclusion: If the Laplace transforms of `μ i` converge to that of `ν` at every inside point, then `∫ f ∂μ i → ∫ f ∂ν` for continuous compactly supported real `f` (`decode_compact`, `laplace_continuous`).

theorem laplace_compact_complex {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} (μ : ι → Measure E4) (ν : Measure E4)
    (hf : ∀ᶠ i in l, AllowsLaplace (μ i)) (hν : AllowsLaplace ν)
    (hx : ∀ (u : inside), Tendsto (fun i => lag (μ i) u univ) l (𝓝 (lag ν u univ)))
    (f : E4 → ℂ) (hc : Continuous f) (hp : HasCompactSupport f) :
    Tendsto (fun i => ∫ p,f p ∂μ i) l (𝓝 (∫ p,f p ∂ν)) := by
    have hr := laplace_compact μ ν hf hν hx (re ∘ f) (continuous_re.comp hc) (hp.comp_left rfl)
    have hi := laplace_compact μ ν hf hν hx (im ∘ f) (continuous_im.comp hc) (hp.comp_left rfl)
    rw [← integral_re_add_im (integrable_complex hν f hc hp)]
    apply ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hr).add
             ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hi).mul_const I)).congr'
    filter_upwards [hf] with i hk using integral_re_add_im (integrable_complex hk f hc hp)

proof_context.conclusion: The same convergence for complex-valued continuous compactly supported `f`.
